Tested on https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/commit/0938a27ae937957c63e3275f00bf730aecdc04bb

## Issue Summary
<!-- Please provide a a clear and concise description of what the issue is below. -->

It seems units may autotarget things they should ignore, such as enemy walls which have NoAutoTarget, or unarmed enemy structures if the units are using Defend stance.

I've noticed this most often as part of an attack-move but I have seen turrets doing this as well.

## Reproduction
<!-- Please provide information about how the issue can be reproduced below. -->

I'm not 100% on how to reproduce this, though I have included a test map and replay below. It _seems_ to happen more often with units that have long range (artillery or D2k missile turrets), or after a nearby enemy has died.

## Expected behavior
<!-- Please explain what you expected to happen below. -->

I expected autotargeting to ignore NoAutoTarget actors and respect unit stances.

## Screenshots / Screen recordings / Replays
<!-- If applicable, attach screenshots, screen recordings or replays to help explain your problem. -->

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5f6db35d-e194-45eb-a2fa-6b09449ff4a9

This was easiest to produce with artillery and enemy-owned walls, so I have an RA test map here: [lab-autotarget-oddness.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26057668/lab-autotarget-oddness.zip)

A replay of that map is here: [ra-2026-03-17T142957Z.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26057724/ra-2026-03-17T142957Z.zip)
